documents.title: North Quay Training Centre - Electrical Installation Tender

pages.heading: 1. Invitation and scope
lines: Tender ID: NQTC-ELEC-2026-01. Issued: 16 October 2026.
Client: North Quay Training Centre (fictional). Site: Lot 18, North Quay, WA.
Scope: supply and install LV distribution, lighting, emergency lighting and cabling.
Include switchboard upgrades, testing, commissioning and as-built drawings.
Work must maintain safe access to the occupied training buildings.
Tender closes: 13 November 2026 at 4:00 pm AWST.
Anticipated site access: 11 January 2027.
Required practical completion: no later than 28 May 2027.
Submit one ex-GST lump sum in AUD and a week-by-week programme.
This is a synthetic evaluation exercise; no real procurement is taking place.

pages.heading: 2. Evaluation and submission requirements
lines: C1 Whole-of-contract price: 30%. Assess the ex-GST lump sum and exclusions.
C2 Electrical methodology and safety: 25%. Assess staging, testing and WHS.
C3 Delivery programme: 20%. Assess duration and credible milestones.
C4 Relevant capability and qualifications: 15%. Assess licences and references.
C5 Warranty and delivery risk: 10%. Assess terms and evidence gaps.
Provide an electrical contractor licence and named site supervisor qualifications.
Provide two comparable project references completed in the last five years.
Attach current public liability and workers compensation insurance certificates.
State warranty duration, start date, scope and any exclusions.
Unverified claims and conflicting dates must be flagged for clarification.

pages.heading: 1. Commercial offer
lines: Supplier: Voltline Projects Pty Ltd (fictional).
Tender ID: NQTC-ELEC-2026-01. Proposal dated: 10 November 2026.
Ex-GST lump sum: AUD 1,184,000; includes testing and as-built drawings.
Proposed duration: 18 weeks from site access on 11 January 2027.
Commercial offer completion date: 21 May 2027.
Workmanship warranty: 24 months from practical completion.
Method: isolate one building at a time; provide temporary lighting.
Testing: insulation, RCD and emergency lighting results before handover.

pages.heading: 2. Team, programme and attachments
lines: Electrical contractor licence: SYN-EC-101 (fictional training identifier).
Site supervisor: Mara Vale; unrestricted electrical licence SYN-EL-101.
Supervisor qualification: Diploma of Electrical Engineering (2021).
Comparable works: Eastbank Library upgrade (2024); Harbor Annex fit-out (2025).
Programme milestone practical completion: 17 May 2027.
Public liability cover: AUD 20 million; certificate not attached.
Workers compensation certificate: attached as a declared copy.
Clarification contact: tenderdesk@voltline.example.

Declared period: 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2027.
